verdict.rationale: Microsoft's own Learn docs have a dedicated Terraform-on-Azure section for provisioning VMs and other infrastructure, plus first-party tooling to export existing resources to HCL and generate Terraform with Azure Copilot. That shows first-party investment in the Terraform surface, but the evidence never names the provider, states that Microsoft maintains it, or shows release cadence. One community comment says Microsoft lags on updating the required Terraform version, which hints at vendor control but also at release friction. Missing for 10: explicit evidence the azurerm/azapi provider is vendor-maintained, evidence of active release cadence, documented coverage breadth across core services, any mention of OpenTofu, and independent corroboration.
